decision: Keep MODEL rules in prose, in short bullet points; defer formalization
claim_prose:
- A Project may use CAPRMEDIO's MODEL directly.
- A Project may define a local MODEL.
- A local MODEL inherits its base MODEL's applicable Declarations.
- A local MODEL may add Nodes, Relations, Properties and constraints.
- A local MODEL may override any inherited rule.
- An explicit override replaces the matching effective rule in the local MODEL.
- The base MODEL remains unchanged.
- Unmodified inherited Declarations are reused.
